targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM zero_result_queries WHERE occurred_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

panels.title: Recovery rate
panels.description: % of zero-result queries where ZERO_RESULT_RECOVERY (NR-59) found a suggested query that returned real hits. Requires the stage to be enabled — it defaults OFF (V47).

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(case when recovered then 1 else 0 end) / nullif(count(*),0), 1) AS value FROM zero_result_queries WHERE occurred_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
SELECT $__timeGroup(occurred_at, '1h') AS time, count(*) AS "zero_results" FROM zero_result_queries WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT query, count(*) AS occurrences, sum(case when recovered then 1 else 0 end) AS recovered_count FROM zero_result_queries WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY query ORDER BY occurrences DESC LIMIT 20
